Counterexample triple_composites_scoped_pseudos.puml matches Java for every cluster and entity but diverges on the DeltaCell-to-BirchCell compound spline. Java ClusterDotString assigns one projectionCluster field while traversing groups; because the edge touches both DeltaCell and BirchCell, the later BirchCell assignment wins. SvekEdge solves the line by recomputing only that projection cluster before DotPath.simulateCompound, so the DeltaCell tail is clipped against its original Graphviz cluster rectangle even though later drawing recomputes DeltaCell's visible frontier. Rust apply_state_border_frontiers eagerly replaces every cluster rectangle before simulate_state_compound, so it clips the same tail against DeltaCell's adjusted visible frontier. The scoped pseudostates enlarge the original-versus-visible frontier difference enough to expose the incorrect update timing.

triple_composites_root_leaf_interleave.puml passes, showing that the stable partition correctly keeps directly declared grouped leaves ahead of unpackaged root leaves for three groups. That success does not cover forward-reference ordering or Java's per-edge frontier-update timing.
